subQuestions.text: Organism A belongs to a taxon characterized by unique aquiferous system, radial or no symmetry and lack of tissue and organ systems

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Organism B belongs to a taxon characterized by bilateral symmetry, lack of coelom, protonephridia and ladder-like nervous system

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Organism C belongs to a taxon characterized by entrocoelic development, pentaradial symmetry and metamorphosis

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Organism D belongs to a taxon characterized by radial symmetry, hydrostatic skeleton and schizocoelic development
